title: Immich: make it better
summary: After first upload works: disk headroom, backups of Immich itself, and one more user. Not a rewrite.

start.body: Uploads already work. Now keep Immich from eating the disk and make sure you can rebuild it.

disk.body: df -h the upload volume. If it shares the OS disk, plan a move before it fills. Thumbnails and ML models grow quietly.

backup-immich.body: Back up the library path and the Postgres volume (or Immich's documented dump). Phone upload is not a backup of Immich.

users.body: Add one household user if someone else will upload. Shared albums beat one giant admin pile.

choices.label: Done for now — keep Immich marked installed
I want the lighter Prism path instead

pivot-prism.body: Fine. Leave Immich running or stop it — your call. Prism intro is the short stub when you want fewer moving parts.

done.body: Immich stays installed. Next itch is usually remote access — that is a separate, careful project. Not today.
